principles: Shipyard is an in-game authoring/dev mode over live runtime authorities, not a detached editor simulation.
Authoring domain and workspace are separate: domain selects what is being authored; workspace selects the active tool surface.
Palette drag release stages an unattached object; move/rotate/scale/snap selection happens before explicit confirmation.
Measured planar contact surfaces outrank bounding-box guesses for generic socket generation.
Typed sockets, bounded insertion depth, collision clearance and character-scale clearance gate final attachment.
Saved assemblies retain editable modules as source and derive a cohesive welded exterior/interior bake product.
1 world unit is 1 meter and canonical 1.80 m player scale drives doors, corridors, seats, consoles, decks and interaction reach.
Cockpit first-person and on-foot first-person are embodied defaults; the legacy overhead game view becomes Remote Fleet Command.
The Blender addon is a client of the same generator registry and request schema used in game.
